title: From structure to function: tunable electrical and catalytic properties in rare Mo(VI)-thiophene-2-carboxylic acid hydrazone complexes obtained mechanochemically
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46194-46206
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07456H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Luka Pavić, Filip Miočić, Marta Razum, Josipa Sarjanović, Jana Pisk
This study focuses on the synthesis of Mo complexes coordinated with a thiophene-2-carboxylic acid hydrazone-type ligand (H2L), obtained via mechanochemical reaction condensation of 2-hydroxybenzaldehyde with thiophene-2-carboxylic acid hydrazide.
